commit_scope: Retire the duplicate line-oriented Compose writer after native configuration publication exposed its mount-target deletion.
evidence_refs: Hostinger run 39134073639 exited 1 before image construction: service volume services.api.volumes.[2] is missing a mount target; the following empty JSON read raised JSONDecodeError.

Native Compose care had published a valid canonical YAML model. The old Python writer filtered matching target lines without their surrounding long-form volume records, manufacturing an invalid mount. Its duplicate build-argument/volume writer and recurring policy assertions are released at their source.

Restored the known configuration from the private backup, then resumed deployment_compose_care.bml on the changed state. The Form model edit preserves existing build-argument references and exact writable mounts while retiring the released router service owner.

The deployment continues to bind the target/kernel source into the image and runtime configuration. Native care owns changes to the persistent model; the retiring host carrier no longer has a competing configuration writer.
No fkwu C/JIT or new host business implementation was added; no kernel or application suite ran. Native care and structural shell/diff reads only.

local_validation.summary: Native configuration care and structural shell/diff reads.

ci_validation.summary: The corrected deployment observes configuration consumption directly.
